name: dev121
about: The 121 audited development graphs of graph-audit-v1 (16 October 2026): views main (91 graphs of the groups E, L, B, S, O, R; weights sum to 1), contamination (29) and apart (UMLS). Content hashes of train.txt and test.txt from the audit inventory (checked before a graph loads); file hashes from the standard suite manifest where it records the same folder, else null (the research harness checked the content hashes only).
